content_sections.heading: ICAR-IISWC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Master's Degree in Agriculture / Soil Science/ Agronomy / Forestry / Horticulture / Soil & Water Conservation / Water Resources Management / Land and Water Management with 4/5 years of Bachelor degree. Candidate having Master Degree with 3 years of bachelor degree must have NET qualification. Young Professional - II (YP-II): Postgraduates in relevant subjects (Agriculture/ Horticulture/ Agronomy / Soil Science / Hydrology / Soil and Water Conservation Engineering / Remote Sensing and GIS) OR Graduate degree holders in relevant Agricultural Sciences / Engineering / Technology (Agriculture / Horticulture / Agricultural Engineering and allied subjects).

content_sections.heading: ICAR-IISWC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum 35 years for men and 40 years for women for Senior Research Fellow (SRF). 21-45 years for Young Professional-II (YP-II), with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per rules. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per rule; 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC for YP-II. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR-IISWC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR-IISWC recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICAR-IISWC recruitment is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the ICAR-IISWC recruitment?
faq.answer: The ICAR-IISWC is recruiting for the positions of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Young Professional-II (YP-II).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for ICAR-IISWC recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is Rs. 37,000/- per month plus admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post is a consolidated amount of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for men applying for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 35 years, and for women, it is 40 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post is between 21 to 45 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this ICAR-IISWC recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR-IISWC recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICAR-IISWC office located in Koraput, Odisha, with the pincode 763002.
